scope: Tangent only (qs_jv.f90). The residual (GENOPAETA_V10) evaluates the ion free-free Gaunt factor g = GFF_VEC(CONT_FREQ, T, Z) at the current temperature; the native VAR_OP_V10 (VCHI/VETA) differentiates the ion free-free opacity and emissivity with g held fixed, so the analytic Jacobian-vector tangent lacked the term through dg/dT: CHIFF Z^2 ED N_ion (dg/dT)/sqrt(T) {(1-exp(-h nu/kT))/nu^3, 2h/c^2 exp(-h nu/kT)}. qs_jv_gff_freq computes it at CONT_FREQ for the ions of COMP_VAR_OPAC (Z > 0, PHOT_ID 1, IMP_VAR(EQION) or QSTARS_JV_VALL) with qs_gff_dt_vec (GFF_VEC's table and cell statements; g checked equal to GFF_VEC at run time) and qs_jv_freq adds it, moved to FL as COMP_VAR_OPAC moves VCHI/VETA, to the directional dCHI/dETA of every direction whose T component is non-zero at that depth. Native VCHI/VETA, the BA, the residual and every product of a direction without a T component are unchanged (bitwise). QSTARS_JV_NOGFF (non-empty) disables the term (build 33 products). QSTARS_JV_STATS line 'ff_gaunt_dT'.
